name: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia
storyline:
Ai'Lynn has one radical objective:

Clone herself to eradicate the "A.P.T.A." that resides within humanity.

To achieve this, she uses her unique ability to enter and rewrite memories.

Ironically, this same ability once allowed her to reclaim the energy she had left within her sister, leaving part of her own memories fractured.

With the help of her ally, Lepheus, she dives into her own fragmented memories in search of the missing piece needed to complete her plan.

As she journeys through the memories of others and revisits her own past, she begins to uncover truths that challenge everything she believes about herself, the A.P.T.A., and the world she is trying to save.
summary:
Anomalia is a puzzle adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds

Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles within fractured memories.

Play as Ai'Lynn, a scientist capable of entering and manipulating memories, as she searches for a mysterious fragment hidden deep within her own mind.
